prompt.project_info: Create a waist-up morning home selfie of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with messy bun, loose face-framing strands, natural skin texture and a soft half-smile, wearing a comfortable opaque white cotton short-sleeve top and simple homewear.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered waist-up handheld smartphone portrait, one shoulder slightly forward, natural relaxed posture, minimal cozy neutral interior and softly blurred background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft side window light with gentle skin highlights and warm indoor ambience, authentic social-media lifestyle mood without seductive framing.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone front camera, slight lens distortion, shallow depth, realistic skin, natural color and subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic waist-up morning selfie portrait of an approved adult woman indoors. She has a messy bun with loose strands framing her face, natural skin texture, a soft half-smile and relaxed confident gaze. She wears a comfortable opaque white cotton short-sleeve top and simple homewear. The handheld smartphone is slightly above chest level, with one shoulder subtly forward and a natural relaxed posture. Use soft side window light, gentle highlights, warm neutral ambience, minimal cozy interior, slight lens distortion, shallow depth, realistic skin, and authentic social-media photography.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, tank top, exposed cleavage, seductive gaze, sexualized collarbone emphasis, nudity, over-posed, studio glamour, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
